name: LMW Ltd
title: LMW Ltd - 500252 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Textile machinery order book rose to Rs 3,300 cr (all booked in Q4) with textile utilisation only 50-55%, while machine tool utilisation 70-75% and ATC order book flat near Rs 360 cr.

utilisation.quote: for us the capacity utilization on the textile side would be somewhere around 50, 55%

capex.quote: we are also adding capacities there. In fact, if you have seen the financials this year almost 50% of our Capex has gone into ATC

triggers.label: TMD order book Rs 3,300 cr
triggers.quote: The order book stands at 3300 crores and that has been an increase in the last quarter

triggers.label: Textile utilisation 50-55%
triggers.quote: the capacity utilization on the textile side would be somewhere around 50, 55%

triggers.label: No price hikes in MTD
triggers.quote: No, no price hikes and MTD division

triggers.label: Textile spinner capex restart cited
triggers.quote: the cotton yarn producers are becoming active, they are modernizing and it is slowly starting

guidance.value: much larger offtake of machines expected
guidance.quote: We would anticipate that going forward there will be much larger offtake of machines.

guidance.value: capacities to yield higher turnover in second half of FY27
guidance.quote: All these capacities will start yielding higher turnover probably once they come into production probably in the second part of the year, current year.

red_flags.label: Thin ATC order book, long-cycle working capital
red_flags.quote: It is a highly intensive working capital intensive business because the raw materials are all sourced from, from abroad.

red_flags.label: LMW Global and China subsidiary losses
red_flags.quote: For the current year the loss stands at 32 crores as against a profit of 1.9 crores for the previous year

red_flags.label: Bank support needed for working capital
red_flags.quote: the bank's ability to fund working capital for us and that is something we need to immediately support on this.

red_flags.label: Mgmt declined price hike quantum
red_flags.quote: We can't anyway tell you how much what we are planning and that's not something which can anyway share with you.

evasions.quote: We can't anyway tell you how much what we are planning and that's not something which can anyway share with you.
The opportunity is definitely there but we don't give out numbers as to what we will do.
